comment: Reviewed corrections and exclusions for the Mathematical Symbols catalog.
Read by scripts/generate-math-symbol-catalog.mjs; every key is hand-checked
rather than inferred, which is the point — the generator never guesses what a
command means from its name alone when this file can say so explicitly.
structuralExclusions: commands that are not catalog symbols. Each one carries
the reason it is out, and the generator copies that reason into the manifest.
A command listed here that also appears in unimathsymbols.json is accounted
for once, not twice.
categoryOverrides: categories for commands the Unicode classifier cannot place
by glyph alone. An override replaces the inferred set outright.
keywords: extra search terms. The name, aliases and glyph are always searched;
this is for the words a user actually types when they do not know the command.
symbols: complete entries for commands neither source has, or that need
metadata neither source carries. The generator refuses an id that already
exists and refuses a command that another entry already provides.
excludeUpstream: unimathsymbols.json records that must not become symbols.
variantSpellings: reviewed alias groups the glyph-identity merge cannot see.
Empty on purpose: that merge already folds \le/\leq, \to/\rightarrow and
\land/\wedge, and every remaining near-duplicate (\epsilon vs \varepsilon,
\rightarrow vs \longrightarrow, \emptyset vs \varnothing) differs in what it
draws and must stay a separate entry.
argumentCounts: how many brace arguments a command takes, by count. MathJax
does not record this — a CommandMap's `_args` is the method's own parameter
list, and \widehat's is ['005E', 1] for a one-argument accent — so the counts
here are the reviewed statement of it. Anything not listed takes no argument,
and the accents and alphabets are derived in the generator from the same
reasoning that classifies them.
requirements / requirementGroups: package attribution for individual
commands, where the MathJax map's attribution would be wrong. \mathbb ships
in MathJax's base `macros` map, which is attributed to the LaTeX kernel, but
in LaTeX it needs amsfonts — so the map-level answer has to be corrected per
command rather than trusted.
noMerge: commands the generator must never fold into another entry. Two
commands are merged only when they draw the same glyph, carry the same TeX
class and math variant, and need exactly the same packages. These share all
of that and are still different symbols, so they are named here. The
short/long family is called out by name in MathematicalSymbols.md §5.

requirementGroups.comment: unicode-math's symbol-alphabet spellings; without the package these names do not exist.

symbols.name: \ensuremath
symbols.description: Typesets its argument in mathematics whether or not the surrounding context already is; useful in a \newcommand that must work in both prose and mathematics.
